question: Who is the Chairperson of the National Commission for Women as on 1 April 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rekha Sharma**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Rekha Sharma is the Chairperson of the National Commission for Women (NCW) as of 1 April 2022.
 
• She was first appointed as a member of the NCW on August 7, 2015.
 
• Rekha Sharma was appointed as the Chairperson of the NCW on August 7, 2018.
 
• She has been actively involved in various initiatives aimed at promoting women’s rights and addressing issues related to gender-based violence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Commission for Women (NCW)**

 
 
• The NCW is a statutory body of the Government of India, established in January 1992 under the National Commission for Women Act, 1990.
 
• The primary mandate of the NCW is to review constitutional and legal safeguards for women, recommend remedial legislative measures, facilitate redressal of grievances, and advise the government on all policy matters affecting women.
 
• The commission consists of a chairperson, five members, and a member-secretary.
 
• The NCW works towards ensuring that the laws and policies in India are framed and implemented in a manner that upholds the rights and dignity of women.
 
 
 
• **Other Key Personalities**
 
 
• **Mohini Giri:** She is a former Chairperson of the National Commission for Women, known for her work in the field of women's rights and empowerment.
 
• **Swati Maliwal:** She is the Chairperson of the Delhi Commission for Women, known for her activism and efforts towards women's safety and rights in Delhi.
 
• **Jayanti Patnaik:** She was the first Chairperson of the National Commission for Women, serving from 1992 to 1995.
